title: bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2: Frobenius-scaled mixed add/square rho on GT

claims.statement: For every nonidentity P in G1 and every z in GT, return Q in G2 with e(P,Q)=z. If z=1, Q is infinity. Otherwise set g=e(P,Q0) for the profile generator Q0, recover y from the Frobenius-scaled three-branch walk in proof.md, and return Q=[y]Q0. Under the two heuristics stated there (random-mapping collision time on Frobenius orbits, and non-collapse of the limb key), the walk succeeds with probability at least 1/2 and uses at most 2^(12575/100) dense-Fp12-multiplication equivalents, including preprocessing, the pairing, failed orbit checks, and output. Peak memory is at most 2^127 bytes. Preprocessing is at most 2^20 reference equivalents and is included in the total. Nonuniform advice is at most 2^0 bytes. This is one classical cold attack. The exponential table is required.

experiments.purpose: Check that the pinned Fp Frobenius multipliers satisfy c1^6=1, c2=c1^2, c3=c1^3, and that the scaled collision equation recovers y on a toy cyclic group with an automorphism of order 12. This does not establish the BLS12-381 running-time heuristic.
